name: Section Map
description: Visual song-section map and navigation. Optional: Difficulty Ladder v0.12.0+ adds per-section difficulty glasses.

difficulty-ladder.description: Optional peer plugin, used for the difficulty glasses only; section navigation, layout and seeking are standalone. Renders the peer's difficulty_ladder.sections.v2 sectionDifficulties payload (payload floor: Difficulty Ladder v0.12.0) behind window._ddCapabilities.sectionDifficulty. No peer, a peer that doesn't advertise the marker, or a payload entry we can't read all mean no glasses rather than an error.
